description: Remove an event from a project's calendar — every occurrence of it, and every change of one. To take out a single occurrence, cancel it with set_calendar_occurrence instead. Anybody who may write in the project.

batch.description: Your own name for a set of changes — e.g. 'solver 2026-11-18' — so rollback_calendar_batch can undo all of them in one call.

source.description: Who you are, as the history should say it — 'solver', 'bot'. The door (mcp) and your account are recorded anyway.

name: delete_calendar_event
title: Delete calendar event
